SELECT item.submit_time AS submit_time, ${sql} count(submit_time) AS count FROM todo_item item LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON item.user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1
and item.user_id in (#{userId})
and item.dept_id in (#{deptId})
and item.type in (#{type})
and item.submit_time >= #{startTime}
and item.submit_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY submit_time
select state from todo_item GROUP BY state
